$comment: Gear models (hats and helmets worn over the part-built characters), built by tools/content/prepare-gear.mjs from Meshy community downloads in the owner's Drive (CC0 per the owner). Each model's GEAR entry (packages/shared/src/content/looks.ts) names it with `model`. `rotate` turns the download (degrees about x, y, z, applied in that order) so its front faces +Z and its top +Y; `fit` lays it out in skull radii (`width` its x extent, `top` its highest point, `z` its depth centre). At run time each model is seated on the head that wears it (fitModel in packages/client/src/content/headFit.ts: size and height from the measured head), so `fit` only sets the file's own units.
